entries.name: False Light
entries.description: Gold relief floods the wounds and sharpens the hand. It is not a gift. It is a loan.

entries.name: Reckoning
entries.description: The light collects. Hands shake, eyes swim, every motion is late.

entries.name: Dissolution
entries.description: Nyx's veil thins too far; form and guard fray together.

entries.name: Isolation
entries.description: Eris's edge cuts you off from rest and mending.

entries.name: Exposure
entries.description: The Eye stays open both ways; you are seen and struck more easily.

entries.name: Monopolized Sight
entries.description: A grey fog closes in; only what is within arm's reach remains clear.

entries.name: Confessor's Clarity
entries.description: The glass cuts through veil and fog alike.

entries.name: Ophite Insight
entries.description: You see the seam in every guard before it closes.

entries.name: Broken Halo's Ward
entries.description: Snapped iron still remembers how to turn a blow.

entries.name: Sundered
entries.description: Armor split along the seam; blows bite deeper.

entries.name: Apostate Focus
entries.description: Unfettered from the wheel; every stroke lands harder.

entries.name: Veiled
entries.description: Step and silhouette slip out of the eye.

entries.name: Bleeding
entries.description: An arterial cut drains vitality every turn.

entries.name: Burning
entries.description: Cinder-fire clings to cloth and bone, searing every turn.

entries.name: Chilled
entries.description: Ossuary frost stiffens the limbs and slows every step.

entries.name: Pinned
entries.description: Shackled in place; unable to walk free until the bond breaks.

entries.name: Hexed
entries.description: The Geometry turns hostile: Void and Radiant blows bite 25% deeper.
